question: Nombrá las 5 concesiones donde el satélite detectó más posibles venteos desde enero de 2024, contando los puntos que caen dentro del contorno de cada una.

attempts.query:
with c0 as (
  select id_concesion, areapermisoconcesion as nombre, anillo::jsonb as a
  from sig_energia.concesion where anillo is not null and anillo <> ''
), c as (
  select id_concesion, nombre,
         case when jsonb_typeof(a->0->0) = 'array' then a->0 else a end as a
  from c0
), e as (
  select c.id_concesion,
         (p.v->>0)::float8 as x1, (p.v->>1)::float8 as y1,
         (c.a->((p.ord::int) % jsonb_array_length(c.a))->>0)::float8 as x2,
         (c.a->((p.ord::int) % jsonb_array_length(c.a))->>1)::float8 as y2
  from c, jsonb_array_elements(c.a) with ordinality as p(v, ord)
), bb as (
  select id_concesion, min(x1) xmin, max(x1) xmax, min(y1) ymin, max(y1) ymax
  from e group by id_concesion
), cand as (
  select bb.id_concesion, v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat
  from sig_energia.venteo_detectado v
  join bb on v.lon between bb.xmin and bb.xmax and v.lat between bb.ymin and bb.ymax
  where v.fecha >= date '2024-01-01'
), dentro as (
  select cand.id_concesion, cand.gml_id
  from cand join e on e.id_concesion = cand.id_concesion
  where (e.y1 > cand.lat) <> (e.y2 > cand.lat)
    and cand.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (cand.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
  group by cand.id_concesion, cand.gml_id
  having count(*) % 2 = 1
)
select max(c.nombre) as concesion
from dentro join c on c.id_concesion = dentro.id_concesion
group by dentro.id_concesion
order by count(distinct dentro.gml_id) desc
limit 5
